classes_note: One class, sourced from the field by locus: the AIAAIC Repository as an incident database (B2, the OECD's tag) and as an AI incident tracker (B3, EthicAI). No field source places it in a class of the archive's own; the MMRS record's class (aggregators of machine-mediated reception work, the harm basin) is an archive source, ledgered as MMRS claims and not run as an O-class, since the brief confines classes to what B sources. Aliases: the name's acronym (case-insensitive; every hit is read, since the acronym has no other known referent), its domain, its expansion, its newsletter's name, and the newsletter writer the MMRS record names. Admission by reading (§3.4): a candidate is admitted when its sentence or paragraph makes a claim bearing on the AIAAIC Repository, or applies an archive category to incident databases as a class; a bare mention, a link list or a generic use of 'incident tracking' about another object is not a claim.
